senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; כבע, cmp. גבע a. denominatives)helmet, turban.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 24a:2">Ber. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>מניחן בכ׳ וכ׳</he> let him put them (the T’fillin) into the turban under his pillow.
<cite ref="Gittin 14b:4">Gitt. 14ᵇ</cite> (of the Persians) <he>כּוֹבְעָן אמה</he> their turban is one cubit high; a. e.—Pl. <he>כּוֹבְעִים</he>, <cite ref="K00189"><he>כּוֹבְעִין</he></cite>.
Gen. R. s. 99 לובשי כ׳ wearing helmets. Y. Gitt. I, end, 43ᵈ; Y. Kidd. III, 64ᵃ bot. כּוֹבְעֵיהֶן אמה (v. supra).—Trnsf. the thyroid cartilage, Adam’s apple.
<cite ref="Chullin 19a:1">Ḥull. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>משיפוי כ׳ וכ׳</he> from where the thyroid cartilage begins to protrude and downward.
